comment: Crawlable copy for the landing shell and structured data (prerender-seo.mjs). Every line here must also appear on the rendered landing - e2e-ui/seo-structured.spec.ts fails if they drift apart. Nothing here is hidden from people: the shell is what a visitor without JavaScript sees, and React replaces it with the same words.
name: Repsy Coach

hero.h1: Load the week. Watch it get lifted.
hero.lead: Workout, nutrition, habits and recovery for every client, loaded on Monday with the reasoning attached. The check-ins chart themselves.

sections.p: Ask about a client. The AI answers from their goal, level and check-ins, and every suggestion carries its reasoning. No AI plan reaches a client's list unless you choose it.
Search the exercise library and set the dose for every move. It saves as a numbered plan, exactly as you wrote it, and as a template to reuse.

sections.h: See the week at a glance
sections.p: Mark plans Done as clients train. Home shows today's tasks, new check-ins and who needs attention, every time you open it.
Weight, adherence and workouts turn into charts on their own. A stall or a slipping week lands in Needs attention with the reason.
Workout, Nutrition, Habit and Recovery plans live side by side on one client. Build them by hand in the Manual Planner, from a Library template, or from an AI suggestion you approve.

sections.h: Your clients just get a link
sections.p: Each client gets an invite link, sets a password and sees their plans, check-ins, messages and membership in the browser. Nothing to install, nothing to sync.

trial: Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial, with no card to start.
